issues.issue: Is there a serious issue to be tried on the appeal (whether the IAD refusal to reopen should be set aside)?
issues.applicant_position: Appeal raises a serious issue on whether the IAD refusal to reopen should be set aside.
issues.respondent_position: Common ground that a serious issue is raised.
issues.result_quote: It is common ground that, in view of the grant of leave by the Supreme Court of Canada in Medovarski, Mr. Tesoro's appeal raises a serious issue

issues.issue: Would removal before the appeal is decided cause irreparable harm?
issues.applicant_position: Removal would cause irreparable harm: loss of IAD jurisdiction, a weakened case, and family separation.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that Mr. Tesoro's removal pending the disposition of his appeal will so disrupt his family relationships
